approval: User approved the 1.7.0 race head review on 2026-11-27 ("Approve, elf drop 2 cm"), confirmed the heads ("Yes, update headkit") and asked headkit to scale and place heads for every race the same way.
rule: Headkit export multiplies a profile- or nose-fitted head (fitted against the race compact reference in fitFrame, or for Trolls a frame the Troll build allowance accepts) by exportScale, after the Troll allowance. pivot head_g scales about the head_g origin; pivot chin about the point on head_g's vertical at the head's own chin height (lowest front-midline point), so the chin keeps its height. Landmark fits keep their reviewed scale (factor 1). Heads are placed by head_g alone: the body rig carries any head drop (headDropMeters, informational), so a head never adds its own offset.

faceCheck.measure: interpupillary distance between the iris centres (PLT tattoo1 channel 8) of the exported head, in metres
faceCheck.note: Library heads span up to 20% around the median (eye spacing is a design choice). Beyond reviewFraction the export is flagged for a side-by-side review against the race library; beyond refuseFraction it is refused unless raceSizing.outsideBand gives the reviewed reason. The 1.7.0 outliers measured +31% to +40% (Dwarf female 018, 021), +25% (Dwarf male 020) and -23% (Orc male 018). Troll designs paint tattoo1, so Troll rows have no band and are judged by eye.

visibleNeck.note: Body rule, not a head setting: chin to chest at the front of the neck, about 0.87% of stature (Human c8 female). Per-race head drops in the rig meet it.
